title: Being kind on the apps is rare. Be rare.
old_caption:
Tired of swiping on people who never reply?
One kind message beats ten ignored ones. Be the rare one.

title: LA dates are about being seen. Houston's are about being fed.
old_caption:
Is your perfect date about the photos or the food?
LA and Houston agree on one thing: the best date is where you really talk.

title: Leo season is the best season.
old_caption:
Is your birthday season the best season?
Leo thinks so, the other eleven boo. Every season is someone's, so celebrate them all.

title: Libras aren't indecisive. They're fair.
old_caption:
Takes you forever to pick a restaurant? Maybe you're just fair.
Weighing things is kind. So is choosing, then trusting it.

title: Love languages aren't a personality.
old_caption:
Is your love language your whole personality?
Virgo says it is a starting point. Ask your person what lands instead of assuming.

title: Matching outfits are cute, actually.
old_caption:
Would you wear a matching beanie with your partner?
If it makes you both smile, do it. Cringe is a choice.

title: Meet their friends before month three.
old_caption:
Haven't met their friends yet, months in?
You learn a lot from someone's people. Go when it feels right.

title: Mercury retrograde didn't make you text your ex.
old_caption:
Blaming a planet for that late-night text to your ex?
Saturn explains the backwards look is just a view from Earth. Own the text.

title: No sign is bad at love.
old_caption:
Think your sign is the worst at love?
The stars say every sign is bad at it at first. Love is a skill you practice.

title: Your sign isn't a red flag. Your behavior is.
old_caption:
Ever been called a red flag just for your sign?
Astrology describes, it doesn't excuse. Signs describe, you decide.
